title: CobbleAdventures Official Modpack
description: CobbleAdventures Modpack for the CobbleAdventures minecraft server!
body:
# CobbleAdventures The Official Server Modpack

**CobbleAdventures** is the official modpack for the CobbleAdventures server. Everything in this pack has been specifically built, configured, and optimized to give you the best possible experience on our server. Install it, join up, and you're ready to go no tweaking required.

---

## 🔹 What's Included

**Cobblemon 1.7+** The heart of the pack. Catch, train, evolve, and battle with over 1000 Pokémon faithfully recreated in Minecraft's art style. Encounter them naturally in the wild across every biome on the server.

**Quality-of-Life Mods** A detailed minimap to navigate the world, an improved UI for inventory and party management, and dozens of small tweaks that make your time on the server feel polished from day one.

**Performance Optimized** Runs smoothly on low-to-mid range PCs so every player on the server gets a lag-free experience, no matter their setup.

**Custom Cosmetics** Exclusive Pokémon skins and visual enhancements unique to CobbleAdventures. Look different from players on any other server.

**Adventure Tools** Enhanced exploration, better loot progression, and custom structures spread across the server world that reward trainers who go looking for them.

**Pre-Configured for Our Server** Every mod is already set up to work perfectly with CobbleAdventures. Just install and connect.

---

## ✅ What Awaits You on the Server

- **1000+ Pokémon** to catch across the server's handcrafted world
- **Mega Evolution, Dynamax & Z-Moves** — competitive battling at its finest
- **Full Trading & Breeding Systems** — team up with other players to build the perfect roster
- **Gym Battles & Tournaments** — take on server gyms or compete in player tournaments
- **Beautiful Biomes & Custom Structures** — a world built for exploration and discovery
- **Balanced Difficulty & Rewards** — every achievement on the server feels earned

---

## 🌍 Who Is This For?

- **New players** joining CobbleAdventures for the first time
- **Returning players** making sure they're up to date with the latest server version
- **Competitive trainers** who want every battle tool at their fingertips
- **Builders & explorers** who want to make their mark on the server world

---

## ⚙️ How to Join

1. Download this modpack from Modrinth
2. Open your launcher (Modrinth App, CurseForge, or Prism)
3. One-click install — no manual configuration needed
4. Launch the game and connect to the **CobbleAdventures server**

**Minecraft Version:** 1.21.1
**Modloader:** Fabric

---

## 💬 Join the Community

Connect with the rest of the CobbleAdventures community on our Discord at **discord.gg/cobbleadventures** — find teammates, arrange trades, join tournaments, and stay up to date with server news and modpack updates. See you on the server, trainer. 🎮
